subject: Onboarding cadence for pilot testcases & bounded license
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@finex.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding cadence for pilot testcases & bounded license

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call I’m attaching a short MAP draft that outlines the acceptance cadence, what we’ll deliver as part of the pilot, and the bounded-use license language we discussed. The goal is to get a mutual plan so your evaluation team can run the prompt pack + testcases in a sandbox without any ambiguity on retention or downstream use.

High-level proposed milestones:
- Week 0 (Oct 4): Finex confirms scope and signs MAP (MAP_draft_v2.docx attached)
- Week 1 (Oct 11): Redwood provides promptpack_sample.pdf + finex_testcases_v1.zip to sandbox (ephemeral access)
- Week 2–4: Finex runs acceptance tests; we monitor regressions and QA checkpoints
- Week 5: Acceptance sign-off or remediation plan

Key constraints (summary):
- Bounded-use license: evaluation only, no model-training on raw or derived data
- Retention: default 30 days in the sandbox unless otherwise agreed
- Auditability: per-request logs exported for both parties

Please review the MAP_draft_v2.docx (attached) and let me know any questions. If this looks OK, can we agree on a signature target of Oct 10 so we can start delivery the following Monday?

Attachments: MAP_draft_v2.docx (docx)

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@finex.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Finex Evaluation Team <eval-team@finex.com>, procurement@finex.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding cadence for pilot testcases & bounded license

Thanks Mateo — this is great and aligns with what we discussed. A few questions from the evaluation and procurement side before we sign: 

1) Can you confirm the exact retention behavior for raw submissions vs. derived logs? Our security team asks for clarity so we can map it to our IA controls.
2) We need explicit language prohibiting model training or use for parameter tuning — is that in the MAP draft?
3) Delivery format — will the testcases be a single archive or staged assets? We prefer staged (prompt pack separate from testcase corpus).

I’m looping in our evaluation team and procurement so we can get legal/ops eyes on the MAP.

—Olivia
Olivia Grant
Head of Integrations | Finex
olivia@finex.com

Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding cadence for pilot testcases & bounded license

Thanks Olivia — quick answers inline and a slightly expanded milestone plan.

Retention behavior:
- Raw submissions: stored only in the Redwood ephemeral sandbox for 30 days by default, then purged.
- Derived logs (inference traces/metrics): stored for 90 days for debugging, exportable on request. Both are configurable in the MAP but these are our defaults.

Model training restriction:
- Section 4 of MAP_draft_v2.docx has a hard prohibition on using raw or derived evaluation assets to train or fine-tune any model. We can add a clause explicitly mentioning parameter tuning and embedding re-use; happy to tighten the wording.

Delivery format and attachments:
- We will deliver staged assets: promptpack_sample.pdf (prompt pack) + finex_testcases_v1.zip (testcases archive). The delivery will be to an ephemeral read-only bucket with rotated credentials; we’ll share presigned links via a secure channel.

Updated milestones (dates tentative):
- Oct 10: Target MAP signature (procurement)
- Oct 11: Delivery to sandbox (ephemeral access) — attachments referenced below
- Oct 11–Nov 1: Acceptance test window (three weeks)
- Nov 5: Acceptance decision / next steps

Attachments: promptpack_sample.pdf (pdf), finex_testcases_v1.zip (zip)

If you want, I can update the MAP to include the explicit language you requested and re-upload to Drive. I put a working copy here: https://drive.redwood.com/s/finex/MAP_draft_v2

Best —
Mateo

Technical clarifications from infra/R&D side: 
- File checksums: we’ll include SHA256 checksums for each archive and a manifest for the prompt pack.
- Ingestion guidance: we recommend Finex run seed runs in a sandbox container we supply (Dockerfile + runbook) to avoid cloud provider leakage. I’ll attach the runbook to the MAP draft on Drive.
- Quantization / model variant note: assets are model‑agnostic; if Finex wants us to recommend quantized variants for latency testing, we can provide recommended model profiles (not part of the MAP deliverables unless requested).
- Data handling: only metadata and anonymized traces will be available to Redwood product teams for debugging; raw assets will remain under the bounded-use clause.

Delivery mechanics: we will publish presigned, single-use links for the archives on Oct 11. Example placeholder link (will be rotated): https://s3.redwood.com/presign/finex/testcases/v1?token=EXAMPLE

Karthik Iyer
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
